research_notes: A final rollback rule could use repeated unexplained failures at/below cap as a trigger, while independent outages are excluded.
Exact thresholds should be chosen after validation data exists rather than invented now.
Promotion should remain slower than rollback to avoid oscillation.
Revalidation can later restore a higher cap when clean evidence accumulates.
This operational lifecycle is downstream of boundary discovery.
Current probe continues to gather that foundational evidence.
